trigger_start: Click to jump, click + hold to float, move mouse to look, click on pop-up to dismiss.
trigger_01: You have been banished from your people's planet onto an unknown and strange world. You awaken in an unknown place. The air is thick and full of smog
trigger_02: Wandering deeper into the mantle (crust) you start realizing these are the artifacts of a lost civilization.
trigger_03: Your family and friends are just a distant memory now. There isn't a way back.
trigger_04: The world you once knew starts fading. People forget your name. Forget the names of places you knew and cherished. Forget your species ever existed in the first place
